ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels comprising approximately 65-70% of the visible surface and low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels comprising 30-35%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) base with dense, low-intensity (dark) contiguous patches concentrated along the proximal peduncle junction and distal leading edges. Extensive fine-line dark markings create a stochastic pattern across both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Presence of high-intensity circular pixel clusters along the leading edge (bottom of frame) and near the insertion point, consistent with localized barnacle attachments.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High density of multi-directional, low-intensity linear pixel tracks (scratches) ranging in length and orientation across the central portion of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct parallel linear rake marks across the ventral surface and visible barnacle clusters on the leading edges.
